method.depth_rank: Depth chart mirrored weekly (pos_rank 1 = listed starter).
method.attrition_formula: sum over unavailable starters of position_weight x status_weight; game weights Out=1.0, Doubtful=0.7, Questionable=0.25. When a club has not published a game designation yet, the practice report is used at a deliberately lower weight (DNP 0.5, limited 0.2) and labelled 'practice only'. Index is rescaled 0-100 against the worst team this week.
limits: Game status is the official designation, not proof of who starts or plays.
Depth charts are a weekly snapshot; practice-squad elevations are not modelled.
Listed players who were not matched to a depth-chart row are counted, not guessed.
The attrition index is a modelling assumption, not an official NFL metric.
